help.import:
usage: ophiolite import [-h] [--json] [--configuration CONFIGURATION] [--credentials CREDENTIALS]
                        [--target {wells,well-tops,deviation-survey,point-set,time-depth}]
                        [--map FIELD=COLUMN] [--declare KEY=VALUE] [--well WELL]
                        [--authority AUTHORITY] [--sheet SHEET] [--header-row HEADER_ROW]
                        [--delimiter DELIMITER] [--decimal-mark DECIMAL_MARK]
                        [--encoding ENCODING] [--separate LABEL] [--audience PERSON]
                        [--command-id COMMAND_ID] [--dry-run] [--layout NAME]
                        {table,list,status,pause,resume,cancel} [what]

positional arguments:
  {table,list,status,pause,resume,cancel}
  what                  table: the file (.csv, .xlsx, .xls); status/pause/resume/cancel: the run
                        id from `import list`

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json                Print the documented JSON result (errors as {"error": {...}})
  --configuration CONFIGURATION
  --credentials CREDENTIALS
  --target {wells,well-tops,deviation-survey,point-set,time-depth}
                        table: what the table holds
  --map FIELD=COLUMN    table: which column holds each value, e.g. --map name=Formation,md="Top MD
                        (m)" (repeat; a field given twice is a list). Omitted: the table must be
                        in the standard layout
  --declare KEY=VALUE   table: what the table does not say, e.g. depth_unit=m (repeat)
  --well WELL           table: the well a table without a well column belongs to
  --authority AUTHORITY
                        table --target wells: the register that issued the identifiers
  --sheet SHEET         table: the sheet of a workbook
  --header-row HEADER_ROW
                        table: the row that holds the column names
  --delimiter DELIMITER
                        table: the column separator of a text table
  --decimal-mark DECIMAL_MARK
                        table: the decimal mark of a text table
  --encoding ENCODING   table: the text encoding
  --separate LABEL      table: add this set beside a set of the same name with other content
                        (repeat)
  --audience PERSON     table: a project member who may read what is added (repeat); you are
                        always included
  --command-id COMMAND_ID
                        table: the same id returns the same run instead of starting another
  --dry-run             table: show what would be added; nothing is added
  --layout NAME         table: use this project layout's mapping (its target is the layout's); a
                        layout is never used unless named (E89)

usage: ophiolite procedures [-h] [--json]
                            {new,validate,run,register,list,show,enable,withdraw,trust,publish,again}
                            ...

positional arguments:
  {new,validate,run,register,list,show,enable,withdraw,trust,publish,again}
    new                 Write a starting procedure folder
    validate            Say whether Ophiolite would accept a procedure folder, and why not
    run                 Run a procedure on local files; writes its outputs and run.json into a new
                        folder
    register            Register a procedure folder as a private version of this project
    list                The procedures of this project you can see
    show                One procedure: what it reads and makes, its settings and who registered it
    enable              Enable a version for everyone in this project (administrators)
    withdraw            Withdraw a version: it is never fetched or run again
    trust               Trust a version, so running it asks nothing
    publish             Publish a run made with run --from-project on project versions (--input
                        SLOT=@RESULT:REVISION): each output once, under the run
    again               Run a procedure-made result again on this computer; the project says
                        whether it is the same result

  --json                Print the documented JSON result (errors as {"error": {...}})

usage: ophiolite sources [-h] [--json] [--configuration CONFIGURATION] [--credentials CREDENTIALS]

                         [--report REPORT] [--original] [--expect-revision EXPECT_REVISION]
                         [--out OUT] [--force] [--require-all-columns]
                         {list,describe,read,browse,import} [id]

positional arguments:
  {list,describe,read,browse,import}
  id                    describe/read: the selection id from `sources list`; browse/import: the
                        storage connection id

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json                Print the documented JSON result (errors as {"error": {...}})
  --configuration CONFIGURATION
  --credentials CREDENTIALS
  --prefix PREFIX       browse/import: the folder, for example nlog/tubbergen-mander-2/ (default:
                        the folder the connection may read)
  --cursor CURSOR       browse: the next_cursor of the previous page
  --keep-copy           import: add each file as a copy (the organisation must allow it) instead
                        of reading it from your storage each time
  --attribution ATTRIBUTION
                        import: where these files come from (shown with every file)
  --audience PERSON     import --keep-copy: a project member who may later be given access
                        (repeat)
  --rights-confirmed    import: I have permission to use these files, derive results and share
                        within this audience
  --report REPORT       import: write the report to this .csv (or .json) file
  --original            read: every source column as given, not the mapped view
  --expect-revision EXPECT_REVISION
                        describe/read: refuse (exit 4, nothing written) unless this is the
                        revision returned
  --out OUT             read: write the rows to this .csv or .json file instead of standard
                        output. The file is your own copy: it is not shared, kept up to date or
                        checked again
  --force               read --out: replace an existing file
  --require-all-columns
                        read: refuse (nothing written) when a column of the table is not read

help.upload:
usage: ophiolite upload [-h] [--json] [--configuration CONFIGURATION] [--credentials CREDENTIALS]
                        [--project UPLOAD_PROJECT] [--attribution ATTRIBUTION] [--audience WHO]
                        [--use-project-defaults] [--well-notes WELL_NOTES] [--source NAME]
                        [--complete | --incremental] [--scope DIR] [--rights-confirmed]
                        [--declare KIND:KEY=VALUE] [--share-basis | --own-basis]
                        [--basis ITEM=VALUE] [--skip-decisions] [--associate-matches]
                        [--report REPORT] [--fidelity FIDELITY] [--new] [--layout NAME]
                        path

positional arguments:
  path                  The file, folder or .zip file, or an https:// address the deployment
                        fetches

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json                Print the documented JSON result (errors as {"error": {...}})
  --configuration CONFIGURATION
  --credentials CREDENTIALS
  --project UPLOAD_PROJECT
                        The project (default: the configuration's)
  --attribution ATTRIBUTION
                        Where these files come from (shown with every file); without it, the
                        project's source attribution (E90)
  --audience WHO        Who can see the files: project, me, or project members by id (PERSON or
                        ID,ID; repeat); without it, the project's setting for new files (E90)
  --use-project-defaults
                        Keep the project's default for every field a file leaves open (E90);
                        --declare KIND:KEY=project-default keeps one
  --well-notes WELL_NOTES
                        Well context notes kept with every file
  --source NAME         Name where these files come from ("Petrel export"); sending them again
                        under this name reports each file unchanged, changed or new
  --complete            With --source: this is everything in that source; a file it sent before
                        and this send does not list is marked gone (nothing is removed). A source
                        emptied completely is not marked gone
  --incremental         With --source: only some files of that source; nothing is marked gone (the
                        default)
  --scope DIR           With --source --complete: the folder inside the source this send is
                        complete for, like wells/las
  --rights-confirmed    I have permission to retain these files, derive results and share within
                        this audience
  --declare KIND:KEY=VALUE
                        Say what the values of that kind's files mean (repeat); other kinds are
                        not touched
  --share-basis         The files the report proposes share one coordinate system, units and
                        datum: answer them once with --basis
  --own-basis           The files the report proposes each have their own: --basis answers them
                        one by one
  --basis ITEM=VALUE    Answer a basis question for every file that asks it, ITEM in words:
                        coordinate system, map unit, vertical unit, vertical values, vertical
                        datum, depth unit or time unit (repeat)
  --skip-decisions      Skip every file that still needs a decision
  --associate-matches   Link each file to the one wellbore whose name its header names
  --report REPORT       Write the report to this .csv (or .json) file
  --fidelity FIDELITY   For a catalogue manifest on this computer: write the catalogue's fidelity
                        document (osd.fidelity/1) to this .json file, after the report
  --new                 Start another upload instead of continuing the unfinished upload of this
                        folder
  --layout NAME         A table file: add it with this project layout's mapping (E89). Without it
                        a table that matches a layout is not added

  --connection CONNECTION
                        start: the approved database connection
  --table TABLE         start: the table on that connection
  --mapping MAPPING     start: a JSON file holding the mapping (fields, crs, schema_digest), as
                        the workspace saves it
  --audience PERSON     start: a project member who may read the copy and the wells it creates

help.wells:
usage: ophiolite wells [-h] [--json] [--configuration CONFIGURATION] [--credentials CREDENTIALS]
                       [--create NAME] [--is NAME=ENTITY] [--skip NAME] [--create-all]
                       [--link-exact-only] [--dry-run] [--bbox BBOX] [--bbox-crs BBOX_CRS]
                       [--crs CRS] [--limit LIMIT] [--with-source] [--column NAME]
                       {list,extent,from-run} [RUN ...]

positional arguments:
  {list,extent,from-run}
  RUN                   from-run: the folder uploads and table imports the list is made from (1 to
                        50)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json                Print the documented JSON result (errors as {"error": {...}})
  --configuration CONFIGURATION
  --credentials CREDENTIALS
  --create NAME         from-run: create this row as a provisional well (repeat)
  --is NAME=ENTITY      from-run: this row is that well or wellbore; its name stays as another
                        name for it (repeat)
  --skip NAME           from-run: answer this row Not this one (repeat)
  --create-all          from-run: create every row nothing you can read is called, as provisional
                        wells
  --link-exact-only     from-run: link only rows that match a well you can read exactly or by
                        another name; create nothing
  --dry-run             from-run: print the list and what the answers would do; change nothing
  --bbox BBOX           minx,miny,maxx,maxy in --bbox-crs
  --bbox-crs BBOX_CRS
  --crs CRS             Convert locations to this CRS on the server
  --limit LIMIT
  --with-source         list: also read the source row each well is located from, from the copy
                        its import kept (E50c)
  --column NAME         with --with-source: an original column to include (repeat; default: all)
